On my lunch break, I overheard an Arab guy and an Arab lady talking about their spouses. The Arab guy was talking about how they cook together every Saturday, but the Arab lady seemed appalled by the idea of helping to cook, and reported not even liking their spouse leaving the house when there was still housework to be done. Who is respectful of their spouse?
A. The Arab lady
B. The Arab guy
C. Can't be determined
